messages:
emma: Quick ping 1 SummitCare RFP — they want a capability table, POC ops plan, short deployment table (hosted/dedicated/private), and a 3-month price ballpark for 120M tokens/month + 8k embeddings. 48h turnaround. Who can grab which piece?

raj: Ill take the capability table. Procurement specifically asked for separate rows for: quantization, automated batching, KV caching, and model fallback.

sue: Ill do the POC ops plan and deployment note. Will include BYOK/KMS wording and audit log retention options.

emma: Please call out that Redwood-managed weights are not distributable; open-source catalog models can be deployed per license. Also confirm POC-in-customer-aws options.

raj: Note to include: "Fallback: automatic routing to compatible variant if latency or errors spike" and "Quantization: supported (8-bit/4-bit profiles)". Uploading draft matrix shortly.

sue: POC in customer AWS: Hosted=no, Dedicated=possible with VPC peering and reserved nodes, Private=fully supported (VPC or on-prem). Adding canary snippet and rollback thresholds.

emma: Pricing rough: hosted ~ $28k-$36k for 3 months depending on model and caching; small dedicated reserved pool ~ $40k/month commit, or ~$24k/month with burst credits. Finance to confirm.

cloudbot: (uploaded) summitcare_rfp_assets_v1.zip 1 files: cap_table.xlsx, rfp_answers.md, poc_runbook.md, pricing_estimates.csv

emma: Target to send by tomorrow 09:00 PT. Ill assemble once finance confirms discount.

sue: Added explicit line: "Private deployment supports customer-managed KMS (BYOK) and optional HSM integration."

raj: Exported matrix PDF and perf one-pager for 2k context / 512 gen. Linking now.

emma: Great. SummitCare also asked for an SE contact for security review. @sue and @raj volunteered.

cloudbot: (uploaded) summitcare_rfp_final_v1.zip 1 files: cap_table.pdf, rfp_responses.md, poc_ops.pdf, pricing_final.csv, perf_summary.pdf

emma: Sent to SummitCare procurement 2024-05-10T15:12:00Z with note "RFP bundle + POC plan attached. Available for walkthrough."

sue: They replied: "Can you confirm Dedicated POC SLA and whether audit logs can be streamed to our S3?"

raj: Replied: Dedicated POC SLA is region-dependent; we can offer 99.9% for reserved pools during POC. Audit logs: yes, can stream to customer S3 for Dedicated/Private with proper IAM/bucket policy.

emma: Marking resolved pending finance & legal signoff. :thumbsup:
